implementation_rules: Keep all public types renderer-neutral and value-based; no native handle, Skia type, platform API, callback thread, or scheduler contract may enter the new public headers.
Use existing ViewId, FrameId, SurfaceGeneration, MetricsGeneration, SurfaceMetrics, and FrameState typed identities; do not add aliases between identity namespaces or change G3-01 types.

Treat generation value zero as invalid for live/replacement surface state. A replacement must supply both generations strictly greater than the current same-view pair; unsigned overflow or exhaustion is a typed rejection, never wraparound.
Validate finite positive logical dimensions, nonzero physical dimensions, finite positive DPR/display scale, and exact metrics equality at submission.

Surface loss marks presentation state unavailable without mutating FrameState, RuntimeScene, semantic state, or previously recorded historical submission facts. Rebind requires strictly newer generations.
Record PresentSubmitted only after exact current-view/surface/metrics/metrics-value validation. Do not call the existing backend or claim GPU/platform work from this value transition.
Only exact PlatformQualified Presented feedback for a known submitted frame on the current live generations may set Presented. Approximate/None and Dropped/Failed/Unknown never set Presented.
Stale, mismatched, unknown, feedback-before-submit, and duplicate feedback are deterministic, non-mutating dispositions. Duplicate exact terminal feedback is idempotent.
Do not implement CanonicalVisible, coverage manifests, Arc handoff, native proof primitives, platform hosts, Headless raster changes, or a final surface/backend ABI.
Use the accepted prebuilt Skia SDK only to rerun the existing G3HeadlessSkia predecessor test; do not rebuild Skia or modify any Skia lock/profile/producer path.

implementation_design_preflight.scope_reason: G3-06 introduces a new renderer/platform lifecycle boundary and a generation-bound feedback state machine.

fixed_design.current_flow: FrameState already carries typed view/frame/surface/metrics generations and immutable metrics; G3-05 consumes FramePlan through a private Headless backend, but Render Core has no live-surface snapshot or presentation feedback tracker.
fixed_design.target_owner: Render Core owns renderer-neutral surface-generation validation and presentation record correlation. Platform hosts will later own native targets and transport proof facts; G3-06 owns neither native resources nor scheduling.
fixed_design.target_flow: A live per-view surface snapshot is acquired; an exact-matching FrameState becomes PresentSubmitted; a later exact qualifying feedback may transition that same record to Presented. Resize/rebind/loss invalidates prior generation feedback without changing canonical scene state.
fixed_design.prepare_commit_publication_abort: Replacement input and feedback are fully validated against typed identities and live state before one atomic value-state replacement. Any invalid/stale case returns a typed disposition with the prior live surface and presentation observations unchanged.
